description: This file defines the main activity for an Android application that showcases app navigation. It dynamically queries installed activities that match specific intent criteria, displays them in a list, and starts the selected activity when tapped.

classes.name: AppNavHomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity responsible for listing sample activities and launching them upon selection.

classes.name: SampleInfo
classes.description: Data class holding the name and intent for each sample activity.

classes.name: SampleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for populating the list view with sample activity names.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets up the list adapter with sample activities.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user selection from the list by launching the corresponding activity.

methods.name: querySampleActivities
methods.description: Queries installed activities that match specific intent filters and returns their info.

methods.name: SampleInfo
methods.description: Constructor for creating a sample info object with name and intent.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of sample items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the sample item at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view to display an item in the list.
